note: TRANSCRIBED FROM APPENDIX A AND FROM NOWHERE ELSE, which is now the only remaining copy of these values and is deliberate: a config record is the thing that owns a value rather than a restatement of one. GOLDEN_SCENARIOS section 3 used to restate thirteen of them in prose and disagreed with Appendix A on the ladder, saying 8 against Appendix A.1's 5 per ADR-024, in the same sentence that named Appendix A as 'the only place these numbers are defined'. This file followed the named authority and reported the discrepancy. ADR-037 closed it by DELETING the thirteen restated values rather than correcting the one that had drifted, and extended CI-06g's rule from counts to parameters. Nothing in this file changed as a result; it was right on the day it was written.
